votes.motion: Approve the CDBG grant application and that the Chair sign the requisite forms for submittal by December 10, 2010.
votes.quote: mr. alonzo moved that the board approve this grant application and approve that the chair sign the requisite forms for submittal by december 10, 2010.

votes.motion: Approve the recommendation of Hudson Design Group and MRPC to hire Boucher Construction Corporation to construct the Eagle House Senior Center parking lot.
votes.quote: mr. alonzo moved to approve the recommendation. mr. sund seconded. on vote, motion passed, 5 in favor, 0 opposed.

votes.motion: Adopt the Lunenburg Community Development Strategy dated December 2010.
votes.quote: mr. alonzo moved to adopt the lunenburg community development strategy dated december 2010.

votes.motion: Appoint Kerry Speidel as the Environmental Officer.
votes.quote: mr. debettencourt moved to appoint ms. speidel as the environmental officer.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the CDBG application.
votes.quote: mr. alonzo moved to close the public hearing. mr. debettencourt seconded.

votes.motion: Close the Truax dog complaint status hearing matter.
votes.quote: mr. debettencourt moved to close this matter. mr. sund seconded.

votes.motion: Recommend that the Town Manager move forward with the contract with Oscend Technologies for the town website.
votes.quote: mr. alonzo motioned to recommend that the town manager move forward with this contract.
mr. debettencourt motioned to adjourn the meeting. mr. sund seconded.

budget_items.topic: Eagle House parking lot: removal of leach field and mounded system
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The engineer estimated removal of the leach field and mounded system at upwards of $160,000, and the board questioned the high cost of removal.
budget_items.quote: estimated the removal of the leach field and mounded system to cost upwards ===page 2===

budget_items.topic: Eagle House parking lot: lump sum bid
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Alonzo said he does not like the lump sum bid process and wonders if the contractor is expecting a windfall.
budget_items.quote: he does not like the "lump sum" bid process and wonders if the contractor is expecting a windfall.

budget_items.topic: CDBG administration fees paid to MRPC
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Questions were raised about the percentage of added administration fees; the figures were not answered and may be a typo.
budget_items.quote: discussion and questions ensued regarding the percentage of the added administration fees.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Warrants were listed for payment: W31-11, 12P11, 12MB11 and 12M11.
Town Manager projected a $2.5M deficit in FY12 in the five year forecast.
budget_items.quote: she projected a $2.5m deficit in fy12 and would like the bos input

budget_items.what_was_recorded: If eliminated, Special Expenditure Assumptions #23 and #24 would amount to half of the $2.5M deficit; the Town Manager does not advocate removing them.
budget_items.quote: ms. speidel said that under special expenditure assumptions, #23 & #24, if eliminated, would amount to half of the $2.5m.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A 10% reduction in state aid was estimated; Mr. Alonzo told the public a 10% cut means $600,000.
budget_items.quote: mr. alonzo indicated to the public that a 10% cut means $600,000.which is not inconsequential.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The $750K towards the Pavement Management Plan is in addition to the approximate $300K received annually from Chapter 70.
budget_items.quote: the $750k towards the pavement management plan is for making road improvements in accordance with the pavement management system.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A 5% increase in utilities and a 2% general increase for other expenses were assumed.
budget_items.quote: ms. speidel said that generally she is looking at a 5% increase in utilities

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A 10% salary increase for the Town Clerk in 2012, then 2.5% through the forecast, was proposed.
budget_items.quote: she would like to increase the town clerks salary by 10% in 2012 and then by 2.5% through the life of the forecast.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A 3% per year increase in the town's legal expenses was proposed.
budget_items.quote: under general government she would like to increase the towns legal expenses by 3% per year.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The health insurance assumption in the forecast is 10%; Mr. Matthews wants changes to health insurance to save money.
budget_items.quote: ms. speidel told him that the assumption on the health insurance is 10%.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A 10% increase in the retirement assessment covers the annual assessment including the unfunded liability contribution.
budget_items.quote: the 10% increase in the retirement assessment enables the town to meet the annual assessment

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The assumed 5% increase in workers compensation may be reduced to 2% based on an audit.
budget_items.quote: may be able to reduce the assumed increase of 5% to 2% based on the audits results.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The contribution to the stabilization fund assumes a 5% increase, tied to growth in operating expenses.
budget_items.quote: the contribution to the stabilization fund assumption of 5% increase is due to the fact when operating expenses increase

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager wants CWMARS membership paid from the town operating budget rather than state funds.
budget_items.quote: ms. speidel is looking to have the cwmars membership being paid out of the town operating budget rather than rely on state funds.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Monty Tech assessment is assumed based on the number of students attending.
budget_items.quote: ms. speidel said that the monty tech assessment is assumed on how many students they have attending.

budget_items.topic: Police patrol officer and sergeant positions
budget_items.what_was_recorded: One patrol officer per year in 2012 and 2013 and one sergeant in 2015 were proposed; the board asked the cost of fully equipping a new patrol officer.
budget_items.quote: the bos would also like to know the cost of how much it would be to completely equip a new patrol officer each year.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A non-benefit second shift at the Fire Department was proposed for weekend coverage.
budget_items.quote: ms. speidel would like to phase in a second shift at the fire dept. for additional coverage.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: An additional DPW maintenance worker was proposed, possibly to save insurance premium costs; a shared school and town maintenance position was discussed.
budget_items.quote: ms. speidel would like to see an additional maintenance worker added to dpw.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The solid waste assumption is the cost of disposal and recycling; a better number is expected after bidding before fiscal year end.
budget_items.quote: ms speidel spoke of the solid waste assumption and explained that this is the cost of the solid waste disposal and

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A non-benefit Outreach worker at the senior center was proposed.
budget_items.quote: ms speidel would like to add another non-benefit person to do outreach at the senior center.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Monty Tech students built new High School sidewalks and the town saved money by using them.
budget_items.quote: the town was able to save money by using the students to do the work.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The board wants to review the price of the Jones House property again in Executive Session.
budget_items.quote: would like to look at the price of the property again in executive session.
